mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity and economic growth, which expands corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of 3-month INDPRO rise (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 150000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals strengthening residential demand, which expands construction-related economic activity and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of 3-month HOUST rise (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) below 2% signals easing inflationary pressure, which reduces the real cost of capital and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL < 102 (t-test p > 0.05).
